panels.scene: Sam stands at a kitchen counter far away, phone in hand, morning light, quietly wondering, a small green kettle nearby on the counter.
dialogue: I wonder if her morning held its shape today.

panels.scene: June, upright and content, waters plants in her sunny garden with gardening gloves, an iPhone tucked in her cardigan pocket.
The small green kettle rests on the stove. Sam looks at a plain phone with a blank lit screen, relaxed, shoulders easing.
panels.caption: Same shape as most days.
